high_signal_works.summary_zh: ManiFlow 用 consistency flow 将高维动作生成压到 1–2 步，并在单臂、双臂与人形真实平台上验证多模态通用操作。
high_signal_works.title: ManiFlow: A General Robot Manipulation Policy via Consistency Flow Training

high_signal_works.summary_zh: Text2Touch 让 LLM 为 70+ 环境变量设计短奖励，经 sim-to-real 蒸馏在四指触觉手上完成多轴 in-hand rotation。
high_signal_works.title: Text2Touch: Tactile In-Hand Manipulation with LLM-Designed Reward Functions

high_signal_works.summary_zh: LAWM 通过世界建模从无标签人/机器人视频学习 latent action，使较小模仿学习模型跨任务、环境与本体迁移。
high_signal_works.title: Latent Action Pretraining Through World Modeling

high_signal_works.summary_zh: VLA-Reasoner 以世界模型 rollout、KDE 置信采样和 MCTS 为现成 VLA 增加测试时前瞻，在真实长时序任务上纠偏。
high_signal_works.title: VLA-Reasoner: Empowering Vision-Language-Action Models with Reasoning via Online Monte Carlo Tree Search

high_signal_works.summary_zh: CEDex 用人类式接触表征、拓扑合并与 SDF 物理约束，把同一抓取先验扩展到任意形态的灵巧手并规模化生成数据。
